author: sackboy_lbp
body:
Hello everyone! Just a quick question here.
In the map.yml file, we are supposed to put the coordinates of each monument. I see that they are labeled "Left" and "Right" if you want to have one on either side. But are these their left and right ones to guard that I should label under the team, or the left and right ones that they are facing and trying to take over? Thanks!

-Sackboy

title: Map Monument Question

replies.author: Milki
replies.body: Left and Right monuments are corresponding to the team that has those monuments.
replies.body_tagged: Left and Right monuments are corresponding to the team that has those monuments.

replies.author: kycrafft
replies.body: Thought it was the oter way around
replies.body_tagged: Thought it was the oter way around

replies.author: TigerTechnos
replies.body:
As milkcream mentioned " Left and Right monuments are corresponding to the team that has those monuments. " It is the other way around

Here's an Example:
info:
  title: 'Formorgar'
  world: 'Formorgar'
  version: 1.0
  type: dtm
  creators:
  - MonsieurGray
  - Meowfrees
  - UniqueAir
  spawn: -39.5,86,-62.5,-90,0

remove-drops:
- golden helmet
- leather chestplate
- iron leggings
- leather boots
- stained_glass:0
- log:2
- steak

repair-drops:
- iron sword
- bow
- diamond pickaxe

loadout:
  effects:
  - damage resistance:5,5
  helmet:
    item: golden helmet
  chestplate:
    item: leather chestplate
  leggings:
    item: iron leggings
  boots:
    item: leather boots
  0:
    item: iron sword
  1:
    item: bow
    enchants:
    - arrow_infinite:9
  2:
    item: diamond pickaxe
    enchants:
    - dig_speed:1
  3:
    item: log:2
    amount: 32
  4:
    item: stained_glass:0
    amount: 32
  5:
    item: golden apple
    amount: 3
  6:
    item: steak
    amount: 32
  7:
    item: exp_bottle
    amount: 4
  28:
    item: arrow
    amount: 1
 
teams:
  yellow:
    spawn: -0.5,66,-130.5,-0,0
    title: Prospit
    max: 15
    monuments:
      a:
        name: Left
        location: 18,67,5
      b:
        name: Right
        location: -20,67,5
  purple:
    spawn: -0.5,66,5.5,-180,0
    title: Derse
    max: 15
    monuments:
      a:
        name: Left
        location: -20,67,-131
      b:
        name: Right
        location: 18,67,-131

regions:
  yellow-spawn:
    type: sphere
    center: -0,65,-130
    radius: 8
    flags:
      build:
        who: '*'
        message: '&cYou may not edit Prospit''s spawn!'
  purple-spawn:
    type: sphere
    center: -0,65,5
    radius: 8
    flags:
      build:
        who: '*'
        message: '&cYou may not edit Derse''s spawn!'
  yellow-table:
    type: cuboid
    min: -1,68,-97
    max: -1,69,-97
    flags:
      build:
        who: '*'
        message: '&cYou may not break the enchantment table!'
  purple-table:
    type: cuboid
    min: -1,68,-29
    max: -1,69,-29
    flags:
      build:
        who: '*'
        message: '&cYou may not break the enchantment table!'
  everywhere:
    type: global
    flags:
      build:
        who: '*'
        allow: true
        triggers:
          modify_drops:
            type: gold_block
            drops:
              0:
                item: exp_bottle
                amount: 4


The bold states where the monuments a located!
In the list it says A & B
A:
 Name:
 Location:
Do not name it the name of the monument. That will confuse the Plugin
The " Name " section is where you put the name.
All you really need is the name & location

To answer your question. In the YML example I showed you made by
  - MonsieurGray
  - Meowfrees
  - UniqueAir
It shows the position you should need
